completeness.why: The new getRangeMidpoint covers only the range arithmetic; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the preview each keep their own missing/number/range dispatch, while the decision includes those cases and the existing getScheduledAmount already decides all three. The schedule template, with its different rounding, is left untouched instead of being routed through the helper with an explicit rounding variation.

interface.why: Adds a narrow range-only helper beside the existing getScheduledAmount instead of using that helper (with a rounding option for the template), so the real variation (missing/number/range and the template's rounding) is not expressed in any shared signature.

disguised_duplication.where: The null/number/range ternary stays copied in forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, duplicating getScheduledAmount's dispatch; only the midpoint expression was extracted, so the copies look shared while the decision is still repeated.
